text:
Mia Chen: Heads up — Sam Ross starts oncall shadowing next week. I want to run a quick plan so we don't leave any coverage gaps. Can folks volunteer to be primary/secondary for the first two days of shadowing?

Raj Patel: I can take primary Monday morning (09:00-13:00) and do a handoff to Vince for the afternoon.

Vince Ortiz: OK Monday afternoon works. I'm out Tuesday morning but can cover Tue afternoon if needed.

Leila Gomez: I can be the secondary fallback both days if paging goes to me. Also happy to pair on runbook walkthrough today 16:00 PST.

Mia Chen: Great — plan so far: Mon 09:00-13:00 Raj primary, 13:00-17:00 Vince primary, Leila secondary all day. Tue we still need someone morning. Sophie?

Sophie K: I can cover Tue 08:00-12:00 as primary. After 12:00 hand to Raj who is on rotation.

Sam Ross: Thanks everyone — I just want to shadow the full Mon shift and do a paired handoff Tue 11:30. Also can we do a paging test so I see the flow?

oncall-bot: Reminder: runbook link updated -> https://wiki.redwood/company/oncall/runbooks. Key docs: /runbooks/pagerflow.md, /runbooks/pg-deploy-failure.md

Mia Chen: Yes, we'll run a non-customer-impact paging drill Mon 10:15. Incident bot will fire a fake page and we’ll walk through escalation. Sam please watch notifications and acknowledge.

incident-bot: ALERT (TEST) — Infra: synthetic latency spike detected on inference-gateway (no customer impact). Page routed to Raj (primary).

Raj Patel: Acked, grabbing logs now. in case anyone else gets the page I posted quick commands:
```
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=gateway -c gateway --since=5m | grep latency
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood/internal?service=gateway&window=5m" | jq .p50
```

Vince Ortiz: I got the RT alert (test) — looks like a noise spike. Confirming no 5xxs in the last 10m.

Leila Gomez: I pulled the runbook step 2.b (restart router) and we should not restart in test. Noting for Sam: always check for 5xx and KV cache growth before reboot.

Sam Ross: Saw the alert come through to my phone and Slack thread. Good to see it route correctly and show both the PD page and the slack mention.

Mia Chen: Action items:
- Sam: shadow Mon full day, then paired handoff Tue 11:30 (Sam to observe acknowledgement + runbook flow).
- Raj/Vince/Sophie: cover primaries as discussed.
- Leila: lead runbook walkthrough today 16:00.
- Ops: run a scheduled paging drill weekly for new joiners (low-noise tests).

Sophie K: I'll add a short checklist in the runbook for "first-shift shadow" with paging steps and where to find key queries. Putting my notes at https://wiki.redwood/company/oncall/first-shift-checklist.md

Mia Chen: Nice. Also flagged a minor coverage gap Tue 07:00-08:00 — if anyone can swap or take a partial early slot pls say now, otherwise I'll ask on rotation to swap.

Raj Patel: I can start Tue 07:30 and take to 11:30 if that helps. Vince can pick up 11:30 handoff.

Vince Ortiz: Works for me.

Mia Chen: Perfect. I'll update the calendar and rotation notes. Thanks everyone — Sam, welcome aboard, we'll keep this lightweight and focused so you see paging, runbooks, and handoffs end-to-end. :rocket:

Sam Ross: Thanks! Appreciate the runthrough.

oncall-bot: Monthly oncall roster updated: Sam Ross added as shadow for 2026-03-23 to 2026-03-24. Next scheduled drill: 2026-03-23 10:15 PST.
